## Attachments

For a scan that read the panel wrong, `poemercpricer dump-window-scan out.png`
prints what the app saw and saves the capture. Its text output is usually
more useful than a picture.

Crop screenshots to the mercenary panel. Leave out chat, the friends list,
guild and account names; issues here are public.
